Mutations finish if the caller disconnects; a save may have succeeded before a later error. Reload participation and the saved catalog after an uncertain response; never blindly retry. Revision conflicts return 409 participation_changed. Present returns fresh permission-filtered presentation metadata while pending; accepted and ignored results return presentation: null. A presentation lookup failure precedes the present mutation; present may reuse an edge admission from the last 15 s. Accept and ignore never require a presentation lookup, and accept always rechecks admission.
